artworks.title: My Poor Sweet Little Angelica
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image features a baby lying on a cushioned surface. The baby is on its back with its head turned slightly to the side. The facial features are gentle, with wide eyes, a small nose, and an open mouth. The baby's hair is sparse. The baby is wrapped in a light fabric, likely a blanket or garment, covering the lower body. The shoulders and arms are exposed. The baby rests on soft bedding or a cushion. There is no jewelry or objects in the baby's hands. The background is a plain, light-colored surface, with some age-related marks. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten note with words such as "little angel" and a poetic line. The focus is on the delicate depiction of the infant.

artworks.title: Minerva
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33.9 x 25 cm (13 3/8 x 9 13/16 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a female figure seated on clouds. The central figure wears a helmet with plumes and flowing robes. She holds a spear and rests her hand on a shield with a frightening face. An owl sits beside her. Surrounding elements include spears and helmets. Two smaller scenes in the background depict a chariot and a group of figures. The drawing style is detailed and dynamic, with ornate borders and weapon illustrations.

artworks.title: Head of a Faun
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait capturing the side profile of a figure's head and a partial view of the upper shoulder. The figure faces to the left and appears to be slightly leaning forward. The figure has a prominent, elongated nose, a full beard, wild, naturally styled hair with a wreath made of leaves and grapes, and small, curved horns on the forehead. The clothing is nondescript, suggesting a single garment draped over the shoulder. The background is crosshatched, creating a textured effect. There are no additional objects in the background, maintaining focus on the figure's profile.

artworks.title: Ephraim Bonus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 34 x 26.2 cm (13 3/8 x 10 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a seated man. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has curly hair that reaches his collar, a full beard and mustache, deeply set eyes, and a slightly downturned mouth. The man is dressed in a dark robe with a row of buttons running down the center and a white collar. He is wearing a cap on his head. His right hand rests on a large hat on his knee. Behind him, there is an elaborately crafted chair back with a lion's head carving, and in the background, there is a partially visible column.

artworks.title: An Imaginary Prison
artworks.description: This drawing shows an architectural interior with arches and staircases. The composition highlights a complex structure with vaulted arches, heavy stonework, and intersecting stairways. Large vertical structures create grandeur, while cross-hatching and shading emphasize the stone and beams' texture. The drawing evokes mystery and complexity, with light and shadow adding to the dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Woman Playing the Guitar
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder, Antoine Watteau
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated sideways in a chair. She has a profile view with delicate facial features and curly hair tied up with a cap. The woman wears a long-sleeved gown and is positioned on a wooden chair with ladder-back slats. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Spanish Steps, Rome
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert and Paula Hershkowitz in memory of Sam Wagstaff
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle view of a grand staircase leading upwards into the distance. The steps dominate the scene with their repetitive horizontal lines. In the distance, the staircase converges towards a complex of ornate buildings topped with an obelisk. The horizon is marked by the roofline of these buildings against the darkened sky. The image is in a negative photographic style with a stark contrast between the black sky and the pale structures and staircase, giving the scene a surreal quality.

artworks.title: Absalom Orders the Murder of Amnon at a Feast in His Palace
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash and white heightening on two joined sheets of blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand, elaborate interior scene. The image depicts a large and ornate room filled with intricate architectural details such as tall columns and richly decorated walls. The scene shows a large group of armored figures gathered on one side, some holding weapons and banners. In the center, a figure is seated on a throne-like structure, surrounded by attendants. The floor is strewn with fallen figures in elaborate costumes, creating a dramatic atmosphere. The ornate borders and intricate patterns add to the overall aesthetics of the image.

artworks.title: Erwin Piscator entering the Nollendorftheater, Berlin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Henrick A. Berinson and Adam J. Boxer; Ubu Gallery, New York
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a street scene with an overlay of a large figure. The image displays a city street view combined with the semi-transparent image of a well-dressed individual. In the background, there is a building under construction surrounded by scaffolding, along with advertisements and signs in German. The superimposed figure is a play on scale and transparency, suggesting a surreal quality to the photograph. The artist used a double exposure technique to blend these elements, creating a unique visual narrative.

artworks.title: Pecheries at Kiretch-Bournou (Bosphore, Europe) (Fisheries at Kiretch-Bournou (Bosphorus, Europe))
artworks.description: The image shows a calm body of water with a small house-like structure and tower on a shore to the right. The horizon is visible, separating the water from a distant hilly landscape with faint outlines of hills and ships. On the left, two elevated wooden structures stand over the water, connected to the shore by ramps. The image has a soft, blurred, sepia-toned style and a color palette of brown and beige. The rocky shoreline leads the eye towards the distant architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Bean Sorters
artworks.description: This appears to be a photographic negative showing a rustic outdoor scene with a ladder. In the background is a brick wall with an open window. A person appears to stand in the window, leaning out and holding on to the top of a ladder. Another person stands on the ground below the window next to the bottom of the ladder. Their features are hard to see due to the inverted colors of the negative. On the left, two other people seem to sit on the ground by a tree or wooden post. Between them appears to be a basket filled with small, elongated items. On the left is a watering can.

artworks.title: The Village Ford
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge extending diagonally across the scene from the right. A cow stands in shallow water next to the bridge, while a person walks away from the viewer along the path. The horizon is not clearly defined, with the sky meeting the trees at a higher point in the composition. The illustration features detailed linework, cross-hatched shading, and textures defining the wooden structures and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly consisting of sepia tones.

artworks.title: Old Willesley House
artworks.description: The scene depicts a pastoral landscape with gentle slopes, a cluster of buildings, and a high horizon line. The rooftops of rustic houses and tall trees stand out against the sky. The image features fine, detailed lines characteristic of etching. The color palette is monochrome with varying intensities of black and light brown. Grazing animals are depicted in the foreground, with cottages and foliage in the middle ground. The background merges with the sky, which is lightly clouded.

artworks.title: Eagham Lock
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterway with wooden structures extending into it. The perspective is at water level, with trees lining the banks. The artwork is detailed and uses a monochromatic color palette of grays and blacks to depict the scene.

artworks.title: The Ponte Salario with Laundresses
artworks.medium: gouache on laid paper mounted on cardboard
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient stone bridge crossing a river. Distant hills and sailing vessels are visible on the horizon. A tower-like structure is situated on the left of the bridge, adorned with greenery and fabric. People are crossing the bridge or tending to tasks. The architecture is detailed, with precise brushstrokes. The color palette consists of earthy tones for the bridge and soft blues for the sky and water.

artworks.title: A Clump of Trees by a Rocky Stream in the Ramsau
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees and rocks from a slightly elevated perspective. The terrain stretches towards a mild incline in the distance. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, capturing textures of tree bark and movement of leaves. The color palette is subdued with earthy tones, soft greens, and browns. Closest to us are rough rocks and green vegetation, transitioning into sketched tree branches in the background.

artworks.title: A Ceiling with Apollo Presiding over Military and Historical Learning
artworks.medium: watercolor, pen and gray ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Diane Allen Nixon and Ailsa Mellon Bruce and Professor William B. O'Neal Funds
artworks.description: This painting features a central panel with a group of figures surrounded by ornamental designs. The figures are situated on a heavenly platform, with mythical themes suggested by their attire and activities. In the background, there are cherub-like figures and clouds. The surrounding frame is highly decorative, with floral motifs and scrollwork. The color palette includes muted pastels and gold tones. This painting is in the style of Giovanni Battista Tiepolo.

artworks.title: Three Muses and a Gesturing Putto
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in flowing robes from knee-level upwards. The central person holds an open book, looking downward, with curly hair framing their face. The figure on the left gestures towards the book, and the figure on the right looks on with a tilted head. Above them, a nude cherubic figure with wings is flying. The background is subtly shaded with fine lines for depth, enclosed within a cross-shaped frame that includes all figures.

artworks.title: The Hare (Le Lièvre)
artworks.artist: Félix Bracquemond after Albert de Balleroy
artworks.medium: etching and stipple on wove paper
artworks.description: This print shows a hare in an open landscape. The hare is in the center, its ears up and alert, its face turned to the right. The ground around the hare is textured, suggesting grass or brush, with some twigs and tall grass on the right side of the print. In the background, there are gently rendered hills and the dark shapes of other hares running and jumping. The sky is light and clear.

artworks.title: Le Feu (Fire)
artworks.artist: Jean Couvay (formerly attributed to Gilles Rousselet), after Grégoire Huret
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, with one hand near their face, possibly adjusting something. They have curly shoulder-length hair and distinct facial features with a composed expression. The person is wearing a long, elegant dress with wide sleeves, detailed lace, and embroidery. Behind them are ornate benches, a table with various objects, and intricate décor. The background features geometric wall designs and patterned floor tiles.

artworks.title: La Retorique (Rhetoric)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in an elegant pose. The person is facing forward with one arm raised, holding a staff decorated with serpentine motifs, while the other hand extends outward holding a scroll. The individual has a serene facial expression, delicate facial features, long wavy hair cascading around the shoulders, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a ribbon and feather. They wear an adorned gown with lace details, a belt, and decorative buttons, as well as a necklace. The background shows an ornate interior with drapery and detailed wall paneling.

artworks.title: Trenton Falls, New York
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing elegantly from a rocky shelf into a calm pool below. The viewpoint is low next to the water, offering a close view of the scene. Trees and rocky ledges hide the horizon in the background, with the waterfall as the focal point. The textures of the rocks and the smooth water contrast. The monochrome photo features sepia tones, emphasizing the rock and water colors. Trees at the top add depth and a natural touch to the scene, creating a rugged yet serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Saint John Preaching
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in draped clothing arranged in dynamic poses. The scene showcases a collection of figures, some sitting, others standing, all positioned in a way that suggests interaction or a narrative flow. The artist employs strong lines and shading to suggest volume and depth, highlighting the flowing fabrics and muscular forms of the figures. The overall composition is rich with details, such as the folds in the clothing and the expressions on the faces, suggesting movement and emotion among the figures. The style resembles that of the High Renaissance or Mannerist period.

artworks.title: Four Horsemen
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of four individuals. The leftmost figure has long hair and a wide-brimmed hat, facing away. The next figure, on horseback, also has long hair and a wide-brimmed hat, facing forward. The third figure, standing next to the horse, has a similar hairstyle and hat, facing slightly to the right. The fourth figure stands on the far right with long hair and a wide-brimmed hat, holding an object. All individuals wear period-style shirts and hats. The background is plain, and the sketch is on discolored paper.
